_source: docs/DYNAMIC-GATE-PLAN.md P3. One home for 'this row failed, so do this': read by scripts/gate_feedback.py, rca.py, gate_report.py and debug_audio.py --feedback. A row entry wins over its tier's default, and the tier default wins over the fallback. `cost` is what the fix costs: none (a note in the report), render (re-run the mix), session (re-perform or re-record), code (a bug in the engine, not the piece).

1.do_next: fix this before anything below it: it is a broken file, a broken delivery or a broken decode, and no musical decision makes it acceptable

2.do_next: this row is the piece's own promise: change the notes, the arrangement or the direction sheet that made the promise - do not relax the number unless rca.py shows the piece was right and the row was wrong

3.do_next: telemetry, not a verdict: note the number, decide with your ears, and do not chase it

clipping.do_next: find the loudest 20 ms with rca.py (it names the band and the stem), then either drop that stem's peak 1-3 dB, shorten the transient with a 2-5 ms attack, or let the limiter take it: the master must not carry samples at 0 dBFS

true_peak.do_next: set the limiter ceiling so the true peak (oversampled, not the sample peak) lands under the target: leave 1 dB of inter-sample headroom, or oversample the limiter 4x

loudness.do_next: the integrated loudness misses the delivery target: change the master gain, not the mix balance; if the target and the piece disagree, the target is a delivery decision to record in `gate`

silence.do_next: a silent gap sits inside the piece where the sheet did not declare one: either fill it (a held pad, a tail) or declare the rest on the hit (`silence_after_s`) so the row and the scene agree

dropout.do_next: a stem or the mix falls to nothing outside a declared rest: check the note durations against the section edge (the renderer clips a note at the bar line), and check the reverb tail
where: score notes at the section edge

cut.hard.do_next: a waveform step: fade the cut over 5-20 ms, or move the cut to a zero crossing; a hard cut is only right on a hit the sheet declares

clicks.do_next: find the click time in rca.py; it is usually a one-shot cut short or a DC step: fade it, or fix the sample start

stem.dead.do_next: a stem carries no signal: the track has notes the renderer dropped (an unknown instrument, a mute, a zero velocity) - fix the track, not the mix

stem.dropout.do_next: a stem goes silent mid-phrase: a note shorter than the phrase, a rest written in the wrong beat, or an instrument release that ends before the next note

stem.clipping.do_next: the stem itself clips before the mix: lower that instrument's velocity or its preset gain, do not fix it in the master

channel.bars.do_next: a channel is out of phase or silent for whole bars: check the pan and the width of that stem; a mono-sum cancellation shows here before the fold rows do

natural.aliasing.do_next: inharmonic energy above the fundamental: raise the oversampling on that instrument, or lower the top partial with a filter; a synth patch with a hard edge aliases when the note is high

roughness.do_next: clashing partials through the whole piece: separate the chord voices by at least a minor third in the register where they collide, or notch the clashing frequency; a scene role may waive this ceiling inside its own windows (`waive_ceiling`)

masking.vs_melody.do_next: the figure loses its ERB band to a bed: notch the bed 2-4 dB at the collision frequency, pan the two apart, or thin the bed while the figure plays; inside a declared dialogue window the margin is tighter on purpose

feel.contour.do_next: the line leaps more than the idiom does: reshape the phrase so most moves are steps and the leaps land on the strong beat; a role may waive this ceiling for a peak (`waive_ceiling: [feel.contour]`)

feel.resolution.do_next: tension notes are left unresolved against the piece's own gravity: resolve them at the phrase end, or declare the role that is allowed to leave them open (`huron_resolution_gravity: RELAX`)

feel.witek.do_next: the bar-level syncopation sits in the WARN band (4.8-5.5) or over the fail limit: move one accent off the beat, or make the pocket plainly on-beat; a rupture role is judged by its own floor (`bsi_min`)

feel.groove.do_next: the parts do not lock: align the bass and drum onsets to the same grid, or write the counter-rhythm a subdivision away from the kick instead of a few ticks

feel.spiral.do_next: the tension does not spiral: the piece holds one harmonic state, or teleports to another - change the chord under the build, not the notes above it

shape.contrast.do_next: the sections do not differ: change velocity, density or register between them; a piece whose sections are the same section is one section

section.energy.do_next: the rendered level does not follow the declared section energy: either the parts playing do not match the sheet's energy number, or the mix is riding the master - fix the arrangement or the declared energy, in that order

scene.arc_step.do_next: the peak does not stand above its build: add a register, a harmony or a density step at the peak, or lower the build; a suspense cue carried by pulse alone fails this honestly

scene.hit_surprise.do_next: a hard hit lands with nothing new on it: put the leap, the register change or the impact ON the hit, not a beat after it

scene.release_delta.do_next: the release does not release: move the harmony home, thin the texture or slow the pulse in the release window; a cut in the picture is not a resolution in the music

scene.dialogue_mask.do_next: the figure collides with a voice while it speaks: thin or notch the figure inside the dialogue window, or move the figure out of that register for the line

scene.silence_honoured.do_next: the sheet declares a rest and the master is not silent there: stop the sustained voices on the hit, and do not glide into the rest

scene.bed_stability.do_next: a bed keeps sounding through a declared rest: gate the ambience on the hit, or declare the rest ends where the bed actually comes back

scene.macro_contrast.do_next: the piece has no range: change the quietest and the loudest section so they differ by the floor, or set `min_sections` honestly for a one-section cue

pattern.loop_short.do_next: a part repeats without change for the whole piece: write a second bar, or let the part drop out for a section

tempo.audio.do_next: the measured tempo disagrees with the declared one: either the tempo map is wrong or the beat tracker locked onto a subdivision - if it is the tracker, record a measured skip with its reason in the score `gate`

outputs.do_next: a delivery format was not produced or failed its own measurement: check the ffmpeg build and the target's spec before re-rendering

expression.preset.do_next: the piece asks for an expression profile this project does not have: add it under the project's presets, or declare the piece's own figures in the score

scene.preset.do_next: the `scene` block does not validate: the message names the role, the key and its range - fix the block or the role contract, never both at once

fallback.do_next: read the row's detail: it names the measurement and the value. If the cause is not obvious, run `python3 scripts/rca.py <project> --row <name>` before changing anything
